source.bookSourceComment:
UAA小说·言璃版 v3.4 

2026-09-28 新版API适配+限流免疫版

【本轮核心修复】
1、UAA二次改版：旧搜索API(/api/novel/app/novel/search)已404废弃。

2、新版接口改为/novel/load，返回JSON且字段结构不变。

3、发现页204个入口+搜索URL全部迁移新接口，参数完全兼容。

4、实测榜单/分类/NTR标签/翻页全部正常(都市15590本、NTR6299本)。

【如果还遇到限流提示】
1、点书源菜单「登录」→浏览器打开UAA
2、随便打开一本书的章节→弹出验证码→输入算术结果→解封
3、或等约10分钟自动解除

【说明】
1、游客模式(enabledCookieJar=false),登录态无益
2、UAA新限制:游客搜索被服务器丢弃,搜索需登录态才可用
3、会员章节(目录标"注册会员")游客只能看前几段预览,属正常权限
4、限速3400毫秒/请求+假Cookie(novel=1)已内置,免疫限流

source.bookSourceComment:
UAA小说·言璃版 v3.6 

2026-09-28 登录态完善+付费提示版

【本轮核心修复】
1、登录态验证通过：token已正常写入cookie jar，loggedIn=true。

2、正文规则补全4种错误码提示，不再一律显示"预览"：
   · code 478 → 限流封禁（附解封步骤）
   · code 3   → 余额不足（付费墙说明）
   · code 4   → 需购买本章
   · code 1   → 需登录

3、广告词收窄，避免误删正文（Chrome/Safari/VPN改为整句匹配）。

【重要说明·付费墙】
1、会员章节需账号等级足够；付费章节需U币余额，书源无法绕过。

2、判断方法：目录章节后标签为"注册会员"则注册可读，"VIP"则需付费。

3、如遇"余额不足"提示，说明该章是付费章节，请找免费作品或官网充值。

【如何强制重新登录】
cookie是App全局共享的，删除书源不会清除，所以重装后仍显示已登录（正常）。

如需彻底退出重登：
1、App设置 → 其他设置 → 清除Cookie（不同版本位置略有差异）

2、或浏览器访问 https://www.uaa.com/logout 登出后，再点书源「登录」

3、然后重新输入账号密码+图形验证码登录。

【限流防护】
1、concurrentRate=3400毫秒已内置，正常阅读不会触发封禁。

2、如遇限流，浏览器打开任意章节输验证码解封，或等约10分钟。

3、请勿使用「下载全书」，会绕过限速连发请求。

    }
}

source.exploreUrl:
<js>
discover = [];
push = (title, url, style) => discover.push({ title: title, url: url, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: style } });
addSlots = (count, style) => {
    remainder = count % 3;
    slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("收藏夹", null, 1);
try {
    favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
    if (favored.includes("Token不合法或者过期")) {
        push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    } else {
        favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {
            push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&sort=update`, 0.25);
        });
        addSlots(favoredData.length, 0.25);
    }
} catch (e) {
    push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
};
push("来源", null, 1);
providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=${index}`;
    push(sort, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(sorts.length, 0.25);
JSON.stringify(discover);
</js>

source.searchUrl:
<js>
providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?books\d?\.fishhawk\.top\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
for (provider in providers) {
    match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    } else {
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
    }
    url
}
</js>

source.exploreUrl:
<js>
discover = [];
push = (title, url, style) => discover.push({ title: title, url: url, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: style } });
addSlots = (count, style) => {
    remainder = count % 3;
    slotsAdd = remainder === 0 ? 0 : 3 - remainder;
    for (i = 0; i < slotsAdd; i++) {
        push("", null, style);
    }
};
push("收藏夹", null, 1);
try {
    favored = java.ajax(`${baseUrl}/api/user/favored`);
    if (favored.includes("Token")) {
        push("账号未登录", null, 0.25);
        addSlots(1, 0.25);
    } else {
        favoredData = JSON.parse(favored).favoredWeb;
        favoredData.forEach(item => {
            push(item.title, `/api/user/favored-web/${item.id}?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=30&sort=update`, 0.25);
        });
        addSlots(favoredData.length, 0.25);
    }
} catch (e) {
    push("未知错误", null, 0.25);
    addSlots(1, 0.25);
};
push("来源", null, 1);
providers = ["全部", "kakuyomu", "syosetu", "novelup", "hameln", "pixiv", "alphapolis"];
providers.forEach(provider => {
    url = provider === "全部" ? 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${providers.slice(1).join('%2C')}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0` : 
        `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=${provider}&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(provider, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(providers.length, 0.25);
push("类型", null, 1);
types = ["全部", "连载中", "已完结", "短篇"];
types.forEach((type, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=${index}&level=0&translate=0&sort=0`;
    push(type, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(types.length, 0.25);
push("排序", null, 1);
sorts = ["更新", "点击"];
sorts.forEach((sort, index) => {
    url = `/api/novel?page={{(page-1)}}&pageSize=20&query=&provider=kakuyomu%2Csyosetu%2Cnovelup%2Chameln%2Cpixiv%2Calphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=${index}`;
    push(sort, url, 0.25);
});
addSlots(sorts.length, 0.25);
JSON.stringify(discover);
</js>

    username = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号");
    password = source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码");
    url = `${baseUrl}/api/auth/sign-in`;
    body = JSON.stringify({
        emailOrUsername: username,
        password: password
    });
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    };
    response = java.post(url, body, headers);
    responseBody = response.body();
    authorizationObject = {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${responseBody}`
    };
    header = JSON.stringify(authorizationObject);
    source.putLoginHeader(header);
}
login();

<js>
providers = {
    kakuyomu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?kakuyomu\.jp\/works\/(\d+)/,
    syosetu: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(ncode|novel18)\.syosetu\.com\/(\w+)/,
    novelup: /(?:https?:\/\/)?novelup\.plus\/story\/(\d+)/,
    hameln: /(?:https?:\/\/)?syosetu\.org\/novel\/(\d+)/,
    pixiv: /(?:https?:\/\/)?(www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/series\/(\d+)|www\.pixiv\.net\/novel\/show\.php\?id=(\d+))/,
    alphapolis: /(?:https?:\/\/)?www\.alphapolis\.co\.jp\/novel\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/,
    sakura: /(?:https?:\/\/)?books\d?\.fishhawk\.top\/(?:api\/)?novel\/(\w+)\/([\w-]+)/
};
for (provider in providers) {
    match = key.match(providers[provider]);
    if (match) {
        providerId = provider === 'sakura' ? match[1] : provider;
        novelId = provider === 'alphapolis' ? `${match[1]}-${match[2]}` : provider === 'pixiv' ? (match[3] ? `s${match[3]}` : match[2]) : (match[2] || match[1]);
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel/${providerId}/${novelId}`;
        break;
    } else {
        url = `${baseUrl}/api/novel?page=${page-1}&pageSize=20&query=${key}&provider=kakuyomu,syosetu,novelup,hameln,pixiv,alphapolis&type=0&level=0&translate=0&sort=1`;
    }
    url
}
</js>

bookInfoRule.init:
<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + og('description').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>

const list = [];
const push = (title,url,size) => list.push({
	 title,
	 url,
	 style: {layout_flexBasisPercent: size}
});


function getHost(sn, cfg) {
  var v = source.getVariable();
  if (v) {
    v = trimSlash(String(v));
    for (var k in SITES) {
      if (trimSlash(SITES[k].url) === v) return v;
    }
  }
  return trimSlash(cfg.url);
}

let siteName = String(cache.get("siteName") || "一夜春宵");
let siteCfg = SITES[siteName] || SITES["一夜春宵"];
let mul = siteCfg.mul;
let host = getHost(siteName, siteCfg);
source.setVariable(host);

const sourceType = Object.keys(myFx);
// 首次导入 infoMap 为空，默认显示「小说」分类
let mySelect = infoMap["sel"] || sourceType[0];
if (!infoMap["sel"]) infoMap["sel"] = mySelect;
list.push({
	 "title": "sel",
	 "viewName": "'模式'",
	 "type": "select",
	 "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
	 "chars": sourceType,
	 "default": mySelect,
	 "style": {"layout_flexBasisPercent":1,"layout_flexGrow":1}
})

try{
  myFx[String(mySelect)].forEach(fx => {
	   let {title, content, tpl, size} = fx;
	   if(title) push(title, "", 1);
	   content.split("
").forEach(x => {
      let [n, u] = x.split("::");
      if (/^\d+$/.test(u)) u = String(Number(u) * mul);
      push(n, host + tpl.split("$$").join(u), size??0.29)
	   })
  })
}catch(e){java.longToast("
若没有发现列表，点击下拉列表选择漫画试试")}

infoMap.save();

JSON.stringify(list)

});


function getHost(sn, cfg) {
  var v = source.getVariable();
  if (v) {
    v = trimSlash(String(v));
    for (var k in SITES) {
      if (trimSlash(SITES[k].url) === v) return v;
    }
  }
  return trimSlash(cfg.url);
}

let siteName = String(cache.get("siteName") || "一夜春宵");
let siteCfg = SITES[siteName] || SITES["一夜春宵"];
let mul = siteCfg.mul;
let host = getHost(siteName, siteCfg);
source.setVariable(host);

const sourceType = Object.keys(myFx);
// 首次导入 infoMap 为空，默认显示「小说」分类
let mySelect = infoMap["sel"] || sourceType[0];
if (!infoMap["sel"]) infoMap["sel"] = mySelect;
list.push({
	 "title": "sel",
	 "viewName": "'模式'",
	 "type": "select",
	 "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
	 "chars": sourceType,
	 "default": mySelect,
	 "style": {"layout_flexBasisPercent":1,"layout_flexGrow":1}
})

try{
  myFx[String(mySelect)].forEach(fx => {
	   let {title, content, tpl, size} = fx;
	   if(title) push(title, "", 1);
	   content.split("
").forEach(x => {
      let [n, u] = x.split("::");
      if (/^\d+$/.test(u)) u = String(Number(u) * mul);
      push(n, host + tpl.split("$$").join(u), size??0.29)
	   })
  })
}catch(e){java.longToast("
若没有发现列表，点击下拉列表选择漫画试试")}

infoMap.save();

JSON.stringify(list)
